scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Ah, I sense you have endured
a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
啊，我感觉到你经历过前世。
在进入瓦尔哈拉之前，你一定学到了很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Unfortunately, I don't think you're ready to become an Acolyte yet. Please finish learning all of the Basic Skills first.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
很遗憾，我觉得你还没准备好成为服事。
请先学会所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
In the meantime,
I will wait until
you are ready.
May God be
with you.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
在此期间，
我会等你准备好。
愿上帝与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I welcome you
back from Valhalla and
wish you luck on your
new life's journey.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
欢迎从瓦尔哈拉归来，
祝你在新的人生旅途中好运。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth and seek those who need your help. May God light your path.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
现在，出发去寻找那些需要帮助的人吧。愿上帝照亮你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth to seek people who need your help. May God enlighten your way.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
现在，出发去寻找那些需要帮助的人吧。愿上帝指引你的方向。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I sense that you have endured a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
我感觉到你经历过前世。
在进入瓦尔哈拉之前，你一定学到了很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
However, I can tell that you are not suited to be an Acolyte. Please remember who you were in your past life and find your path.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
然而，我能看出你不适合成为服事。
请铭记你前世的身份，找到属于你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
What is it that you seek?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你想要什么？

scripts.text: Change your job to acolyte.
scripts.translation: 转职为服事

scripts.text: Ask the requirements to be an acolyte.
scripts.translation: 询问转职为服事的要求

scripts.text: Quit it.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Are you feeling okay today? I can tell by your attire that you are already an Acolyte. You're not joking around, are you?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你今天感觉还好吗？从你的装束来看，你已经是服事了。你是在开玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I'm sorry but it seems you already have your own job, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
很抱歉，看来你已经拥有自己的职业了，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you truly wish to become a servant of God?
Let's see whether you are ready for it or not... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你真的想成为上帝的仆人吗？
让我看看你是否已经做好了准备... 嗯...

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Oh my?! You haven't accomplished the basic practice yet?! You have a long way to go! Come again after increasing your job level!
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
哎呀？你还没有完成基础练习吗？你还有很长的路要走！等你提高了职业等级后再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Hmm... your job level is enough...
Good. Now I will give you the qualification to become an Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
嗯... 你的职业等级足够了...
很好。现在我将授予你成为服事的资格。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Always remember to be thankful to God, who takes care of us all the time. In chaos and times of difficulty, face your hardships with unwavering faith.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
永远记得感谢上帝，祂时刻都在照顾着我们。在混沌和困难时期，要以坚定的信念面对你的艰辛。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Lastly, I want to sincerely congratulate you on persevering through your trial of penance.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
最后，我想真诚地祝贺你坚持完成了忏悔的考验。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you wish to become an Acolyte?
Then, you must fulfill the following requirements thinking those are the practices given by God.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你想成为服事吗？
那么，你必须满足以下要求，并将这些视为上帝赋予的修行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
First, you have to reach at least Novice Job Level 9 and learn all of the Basic Skills.
This is the most basic thing to do, so you need to regard it as the way of training yourself.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
首先，你必须达到初心者职业等级9，并学会所有的基本技能。
这是最基本的要求，所以你需要将其视为自我磨练的途径。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
When you think you fulfilled this requirement, then come back to me again. Then you will have a holy job in which you can spread God's will.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
当你认为满足了这个要求时，再回来找我。那时，你将拥有一项神圣的职业，可以传播上帝的旨意。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Please take care. They should know that you've met me by the time you arrive at the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
请小心。等你到达普隆德拉圣堂时，他们应该已经知道你来过这里了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...? You must be the one who aspires to become an Acolyte. I've already received news from the Sanctuary that you might be coming.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦...？你就是那位渴望成为服事的人吧。我已经从圣堂那里收到消息，说你可能要来了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...
Are you one of the
Acolyte applicants...?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦...
你是服事的申请者之一吗...？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Huh? What brings you here? This is a very dangerous place for a Novice like yourself!
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
咦？什么事把你带到这儿了？对于像你这样的初心者来说，这里非常危险！

scripts.text: [Father Rubalkabara]
scripts.translation: [鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Greetings.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh ho...
Have you come into the Deep here for training? Or are you just a Wanderer?
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦呵...
你是来这里训练的吗？还是只是一个浪姬舞者？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I've sent a carrier pigeon with a message. I hope it will arrive there safely...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我派了一只信鸽带着消息去了。希望它能平安到达那里...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Now, your name was {0}, right? Excellent, thank you for visiting me.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
那么，你的名字是{0}，对吧？很好，谢谢你来看我。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I believe you've been told much about Acolytes from Friar Mareusis. Plus, there's plenty of helpful people in the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我想马鲁西斯神父已经向你介绍过很多关于服事的事情了。而且，普隆德拉圣堂里也有很多乐于助人的人。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I guess there's really no need for me to teach you much. Besides, I'm sure your someone from your generation may have trouble listening to an old man like me. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我想确实没什么需要我教你的了。况且，我相信你们年轻人可能不太愿意听我这种老头子说话。哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Still, lessons may come from the places you'd least expect. God loves to teach his children in strange ways. You'll see.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
不过，教训往往来自你意想不到的地方。上帝喜欢用奇怪的方式教导他的孩子。你会明白的。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Well, I'll send the message telling them that you've come to visit me. So, you may now return to the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
好了，我会派人通知他们你来看过我了。现在，你可以回到普隆德拉圣堂了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
再见。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Your name is {0}?
I don't think your name
is on my list. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你的名字是{0}？
我的名单上好像没有你的名字。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Why don't you go back to the Prontera Sanctuary and check again?
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你不如回到普隆德拉圣堂再确认一下吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Welcome to the Deep. Feel free to sit and contemplate God's message with me. This place is beautiful, even if danger accompanies its sense of serenity...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
欢迎来到深渊。请随意坐下，和我一起冥想上帝的旨意。这里很美，尽管伴随着宁静的是危险...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Whoever you are, please take care of yourself. The monsters in here are shockingly strong, contrary to their cute appearance.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
无论你是谁，请照顾好自己。这里的魔物虽然外表可爱，但实力惊人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a carrier pigeon to the Prontera Sanctuary. When you return, the Priest there should already have received my message.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会派信鸽去普隆德拉圣堂。等你回来时，那里的牧师应该已经收到我的消息了。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah, you must be one of the Acolyte applicants. I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
啊，你一定是服事的申请者之一。我真诚地欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah...!
You must be one
of the Acolyte applicants.
I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
啊...！
你一定是服事的申请者之一。
我真诚地欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
...

scripts.text: [Mother Mathilda]
scripts.translation: [玛蒂尔达修女]

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hello there~
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
May God
be with you...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
愿上帝与你同在...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will pray to God, and hope that you become an Acolyte soon.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会向上帝祈祷，希望你能早日成为服事。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
What is your name? {0}? Let's see... Ah, you're on my list.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你叫什么名字？{0}？让我看看...啊，你在我的名单上。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a message to the Sanctuary confirming that you, {0} visited me and completed your penance.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会发消息给圣堂，确认你，{0}，已经拜访过我并完成了忏悔。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Please return to the Prontera Sanctuary and speak to the Priest in charge.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
请回到普隆德拉圣堂，与负责的牧师对话。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Now, what is your name?
{0}? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
那么，你叫什么名字？
{0}？让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hmm...
It seems your name
is not on my list...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
嗯...
看来你的名字
不在我的名单上...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Perhaps you should return to the Prontera Sanctuary and check the destination for your penance trial once again.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
也许你应该回到普隆德拉圣堂，再次确认你忏悔试炼的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
How is your practice coming along? I certainly hope you're enjoying living in the grace of God.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你的修行进展如何？我真心希望你在上帝的恩典中生活得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
What?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
Whatever you are,
you look like an
Acolyte applicant.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿。
不管你是谁，
你看起来像个
服事申请者。
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
You look like an Acolyte Applicant. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿。
你看起来像个服事申请者。我说得对吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You...
Novice.
There something
you wanna tell me?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你...
初心者。
有什么事
想告诉我吗？

scripts.text: [Father Yosuke]
scripts.translation: [阳介神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey...
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿...

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Do you have anything to say? Because unfortunately for you,
I don't any replies.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你有什么话要说吗？可惜对你来说，
我没有任何回应。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Have you any more business with me?! You don't! Go back to the Sanctuary now!
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你还有事找我吗？！没有！现在回圣堂去！

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad, not bad. You withstood the penance trial pretty well.
So what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
不错，不错。你很好地经受住了忏悔试炼。
那么，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
{0}，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Okay. I'll send a message to the Sanctuary that you, {0}, came to visit me.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
好的。我会发消息给圣堂，确认你，{0}，来拜访过我。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Now go back to the Santuary and finish becoming an Acolyte, kid.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
现在回圣堂去，完成成为服事的仪式，小孩。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad at all, you've made it all the way here from Prontera. So what's your name, kid?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
真不错，你从普隆德拉一路走到了这里。那么，你叫什么名字，小孩？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh? Why isn't your name on my list?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
{0}，是吗？为什么你的名字不在我的名单上？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You probably made a mistake. Go back to the Santuary, and check with the Bishop.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你大概搞错了。回圣堂去，找主教确认一下。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
If you like, come sit here with me and meditate the great truths. God's majesty is truly inspiring...
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
如果你愿意，可以坐在这里和我一起冥想伟大的真理。上帝的威严真是令人敬畏...
